{{Quote|There's no one else who can do it.''"<br />"''No one who can set a bone? No one who can wash clean a cut? No one else who can twist the head off of a clip beetle?|Jacen Solo and the [[Fosh/Legends|Fosh]] [[Vergere]], on Solo's role as a doctor in the Nursery|<ref name="Traitor" />}}
'''Clip beetles''' were small, [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]] that were created by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In existence by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the beetles had an abdominal shell, a head with a pair of mandibles, and its flesh and shell were both nutritious. A clip beetle's head could be used as a natural type of stitching for wounds; the beetle could be encouraged to bite the flesh on either side of the wound, and the rest of the beetle's body would then be removed. The head would be left in place with the jaws still holding the wound shut.

==Biology and appearance==
Clip beetles were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]] that had an abdominal shell, as well as a head with a pair of mandibles. The beetle was small enough that an average-sized [[Human/Legends|Human]] could crack a clip beetle's shell open between a thumb and the first knuckle on one of their [[Limb/Legends|hands]]. The flesh of a clip beetle was pale [[Color/Legends|purple]] in coloration and was prized because of the significant amount of [[Protein/Legends|proteins]] and fats present in it. To some Humans, clip beetle flesh tasted like [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Cala]] [[ice-lobster]].<ref name="Traitor" /> The shells of the beetles were also high in nutrition.<ref name="Stand" />

==Behavior==
Clip beetles were able to survive in the [[Nursery]], the central chamber within a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Sh'rip Sh'pa|seedship]], which contained [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]], jungles, and hills. When flesh was presented to them, clip beetles attacked it ferociously, biting it with their mandibles to hold on. Clip beetles could be persuaded to let their jaw hold lapse if they were tickled near the head joint. Because of their tight grip with their jaws,<ref name="Traitor" /> clip beetles were renowned by the Yuuzhan Vong [[Species/Legends|species]] for their use as natural stitches with which to close wounds.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|129|clip beetle}}</ref> A clip beetle could be taken and placed close to an open wound, and the insect would latch onto the flesh on either side. By twisting the body attached to the head, the two parts would separate, leaving the head with its jaws closing the wound shut. Wounds could take up to twenty-three clip beetle heads to close.<ref name="Traitor" />

==History==
Clip beetles were genetically created by the sentient Yuuzhan Vong species<ref name="TCSWE" /> sometime prior to [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], by which [[Time/Legends|time]] the Yuuzhan Vong were involved in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a conflict that erupted when they invaded [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Stand" /> The Yuuzhan Vong prized clip beetles for both their nutritional value and their ability to be used as a natural stitch.<ref name="TCSWE" /> During the Yuuzhan Vong War, clip beetles were present in the Nursery, which was a playground for infant [[dhuryam]]s who had [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic abilities]]. There, the captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] made use of clip beetles to both feed himself and close the wounds of fellow [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="Traitor" />

By 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the Yuuzhan Vong fed nutritional clip beetle shells to the immense [[ganadote]] creatures to help the creatures grow.<ref name="Stand" /> Clip beetles were also present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]. The Yuuzhan Vong had [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|captured]] Coruscant from the New Republic, and disgraced Yuuzhan Vong [[Executor (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Executor]] [[Nom Anor]] used clip beetles to help close the wounds of the [[Warrior caste|warrior]] [[Kunra]].<ref name="Remnant">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Clip beetles were first mentioned in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]'', a [[2002]] installment of [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|''The New Jedi Order'']] series by [[Aaron Allston]].<ref name="Stand" /> The beetles first appeared in another novel in the same series, ''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]'', which was released in 2002 and written by [[Matthew Stover]].<ref name="Traitor" />
